title: Night of Revelations
text:
*The night's investigation has given you what you need — confirmation that the Merchants' Guild is smuggling weapons into Ashenmoor. But the scale of it is staggering. This isn't petty contraband. This is an arsenal.*

*As you make your way back through the dark streets, you hear footsteps behind you — heavy, deliberate. Two figures step from a side alley, blocking your path. A third appears behind you.*

Thug: "Harren sends his regards. You've been asking too many questions, stranger. Time to stop."

*Moonlight glints on drawn blades. This was inevitable — but you're not defenseless.*

choices.text: Fight — you didn't survive this long by running
Talk your way out — turn their loyalty with words
Use the alley's shadows to escape
Surrender and see where they take you
